namespace_note: G3S is the StructuralBench exact-certificate lane. It does not open or consume the separate TALON/RDSS G3 external-validity reserve already present on main.
scientific_question: Can a proto-TOS closure distinguish pseudoform, protoform, form, anti-state, nullity and oversufficient-origin mismatch, and produce exact structural certificates not reproducible by a matched formal active-query baseline?
ground_truth_rule: Construct the exact hidden object, transformed hypothesis and certificate before producing O1, O2, adversarial splices, natural-language labels or query pools.

splits.IID_DEV: calibration only; graph, algebra and number theory
splits.OOD_COMPLEXITY: seen domains with larger exact catalogs
splits.OOD_DOMAIN: symbolic mechanics held out from calibration
splits.ADVERSARIAL: anti, oversufficient-origin, protoform and null tasks
splits.PRIVATE_HELDOUT: content-addressed private seed; all four domains and five regimes

matched_budget.formal_query_baseline: entropy-optimal query over the exact candidate set
matched_budget.TOS_query: closure-oriented query over Phi12 candidate partitions

primary_endpoint.name: private constructive exact-certificate success
primary_endpoint.comparison: TOS_FULL_PROTOFORM versus strongest matched active-query baseline
primary_endpoint.support_if: paired gain greater than 0.02 and bootstrap 95 percent interval strictly positive

secondary_endpoints: mean tool calls, candidate evaluations and runtime
hard_falsifiers: matched formal active-query baseline reproduces O3 exact-certificate success
pseudoform and protoform eligibility cannot be separated on private held-out tasks
origin-leak pseudoforms are promoted as form
DIN equals no-DIN under matched exact constraints
